utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll check the donation list, bring tape, a marker, and sturdy boxes, and I’ll come a bit early to help sort.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Leo—you’re really okay coming early to help sort?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — I’ll come early and help sort.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — if we can lock down the tool list and a drop-off time, I’ll feel better about the pickup runs too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around for a tool list and a good drop-off time, then pass it back to you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — that would really help. Once you have the tool list and drop-off time, send it my way and I’ll keep the pickup runs organized.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. I’m keeping the list sorted with housing-blocking repairs first, then safety, then smaller fixes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ve got my gloves and tools kit ready. Send me the job list when you can, and I’ll jump in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I’ll send the job list soon, and I appreciate you being ready to jump in. We’ll start with the housing-blocking repairs, then move to safety issues and the smaller fixes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll keep the front door latch as the priority and check on the kitchen sink if there’s time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina — that sounds like a good plan. Just let me know when you’ve got the details, and I’ll help out where I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Will do — I’ll keep you posted once I’ve got the details. Thanks, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’m still putting the supply list together, and we could use a few more tool-savvy volunteers for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep spreading the word and remind folks to bring any tools they can spare, plus extra hands for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’ll bring the supply list by later so we can match it with whatever tools folks can lend.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I’m still sorting the details, but I’ll let you know what needs fixing once I have the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — send me the list when you have it, and I’ll help keep track of what comes in. I’ll pass along the drop-off details as soon as they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate it — I’ll send the list over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly my front door latch — it’s been sticking for weeks. If there’s time, I’d also love a quick look at the kitchen sink.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can note both for the repair drive, Nell. We’ll do our best to get someone to take a look at the latch first and then the sink if there’s time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send me the urgent ones first, especially anything that keeps folks from using their homes or creates a safety risk.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll sort out the urgent tools first and bring over anything that helps with safety or keeps a home working. I’ll check the shed again and get them to you as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Gus — just bring the urgent stuff first, and I’ll keep the repair list moving.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Dane, could you check the donation list first and bring tape, a marker, and a few sturdy boxes if you have them? If you can, come a little early so we can sort everything before people get here.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’ll check the donation list, bring tape, a marker, and some sturdy boxes, and I’ll come a bit early to help sort everything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — that sounds perfect. Please keep me posted if anything changes, and I’ll handle the rest of the setup.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supplies list started, and I’ll send over anything we’re still missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — could you also let me know the exact meeting spot for the repair drive when you have it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the exact meeting spot as soon as I have it, along with the missing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check the school schedule and set a time that avoids pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye—that’d help a lot. I might’ve missed the schedule changes, so whatever avoids pickup and drop-off sounds perfect.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll send over a time once I confirm the schedule—thanks for being flexible.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the repair drive invite and send the meeting spot as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — send me the meeting spot when you have it, and I’ll take a look at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll send the meeting spot as soon as I hear back and keep you in the loop on the repair drive invite too.
